title: Detect and repair the failure, checked in the game
text: Detect the demonstrated failure with a code check that fails on the broken case and passes on the corrected and normal cases; verify the correction and affected behavior in a real game, including save and reload when relevant. Preserve the original pack and world.
result: `pack-check` saves every dimension the way level.dat stores it and reads it back, starts the same world a second time, and reads back every placed block; it fails on the shipped pack and passes with the repair. The `pack-*` self-test suites cover the checks that need no game.
